name: Resistor Environment QA 17
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Two points X and Y are connected through a 3Ω resistor in one path and three resistors 3Ω, 2Ω and 1Ω...

examples.input:
Two points X and Y are connected through a 3Ω resistor in one path and three resistors 3Ω, 2Ω and 1Ω connected in series in another path, with 1A current. Find VX - VY:

Options:
1. 2 V
2. 0 V
3. 3 V
4. -1 V
